decisions.reason: The downloading-state label is natural and already within the normal compact-control budget.
The label is clearly wide, but shortening the stage at which the cap unlocks requires an approved compact term for the limit-unlock mechanic; repository search did not provide one.
Replacing 'Phần thưởng' with the compact UI noun 'Thưởng' preserves the full Talent Bloom mechanic name while substantially reducing width.
A shorter replacement for 'giai đoạn' could change how Talent Bloom stages map to the mechanic; the exact selector layout and approved stage terminology are not available.
The Awakening Lv increase action is mechanically precise and only modestly above the normal button budget; no safer compact mechanic wording is established.
The unlocked-state label is natural and comfortably within the tiny/pill budget.
The short-story label is natural and already compact.
The UI context of a level field makes 'độ' redundant; the compact form preserves the intimacy-level meaning and fits the header budget.
The consumption label is concise and preserves {0} exactly.
For a favorite-toggle completion status, the shorter state wording naturally conveys that the item is now favorited without the over-wide motion phrase.
The compact completion status preserves removal from favorites while dropping the unnecessary locative word 'khỏi'.
The current text is wide, but the source can function either as an action to complete a transfer or as a completed-transfer status; control context is needed before shortening it.
The combined max-Lv/limit-unlock label is over-wide, but safely compacting 'Mở khóa giới hạn' requires approved mechanic terminology that is not present in the UI short forms or reviewed overrides.
The disagree action is natural and only marginally above a tiny-button threshold.
The end-time label is semantically precise; shortening to 'giờ' could incorrectly imply a clock time rather than a date/time endpoint.
The confirmed-state label is natural and already within the tiny/pill budget.
The duration preserves all three placeholders and exact day/hour/minute units; abbreviating units would require an approved convention.
The random option is natural and compact.
This is a mechanic label; the current potential-unlock wording is clear, and replacing it with a shorter mechanic term without canonical evidence would exceed UI-review scope.
The exchange label retains the specific Unlock Crystal item name; dropping that qualifier would depend on screen context not supplied by the batch.
